excluded.test: emit.test.ts > event emitter > enqueue.emit(…) emits events that can be listened to on actorRef.on(…)
excluded.reason: enqueueActions is not ported (out of scope for the actor layer)

actor.on listeners' own semantics, which are out of scope: the test's subject is a listener that throws, whose error XState reports apart while the actor stays active; the record's only listener is the oracle's own recorder, and no step registers a listener, let alone one that throws. It would need a step that registers a throwing listener for an event type on an actor

excluded.test: emit.test.ts > event emitter > events can be emitted from promise logic
excluded.reason: a promise logic that emits: the root is a fromPromise actor whose body calls emit when it starts; a host actor stands for fromPromise but runs no body, an actor case's root is always a machine, and no step makes a host actor emit. It would need a root that is a host actor and a step by which a host actor emits an event
